title: Nested partial update must merge with defaults and clear stale derived fields
trigger: A UI panel emits a nested Partial<T> object that is saved into a parent object; sibling fields in the nested object can be reset to defaults or stale overrides can persist silently.
principle: When a UI panel builds a nested settings object from a Partial<T>, merge with defaults first so optional fields are not dropped, and explicitly clear derived/stale override fields when the primary field changes. Otherwise a stale override (e.g. per-language defaultActiveTabPerLang) will silently win over the user's new global value and the UI change appears to have no effect.

cases.context: DictionaryPopupSettingsPanel updates defaultActiveTab but keeps a stale defaultActiveTabPerLang; per-lang audio overrides the new global image

applyFor: Nested settings forms that emit Partial<T> for a sub-object stored in parent state
UIs that manage a global setting with hidden/unsupported per-language or per-context overrides
Any partial update where a derived/override field can become stale and override the primary value
